tracks.title: Past Interview Questions
tracks.subtitle: Glencore and Millennium × AmplifyME screens in one bank, ranked from easiest to most challenging
tracks.intro: Every retained question from both screens, ranked together by actual difficulty (level 1 → 5). The source of each question is shown as a badge; filter by source if you want, but the default view is the global ranking.

tracks.title: Quantitative Methods
tracks.subtitle: Four crude and oil-products research projects: a trustworthy dataset, imperfect product data and features, point-in-time information, then econometric modelling and its defence
tracks.intro: Each project is one research question on a desk-like dataset, with its own data-preparation challenge, and ends with a written defence. Work through the steps in order inside a project; the projects can be read in order 1 → 4. All datasets are synthetic (fixed seeds) and deliberately imperfect where the project needs it — never presented as market observations. Training projects inspired by crude / oil-products desk work, not actual interview questions or internal methodologies of any firm.
